title: How people are using ChatGPT
summary: New research from the largest study of ChatGPT use shows how the tool creates economic value through both personal and professional use. Adoption is broadening beyond early users, closing gaps and making AI a part of everyday life.
body: New research from the largest study of ChatGPT use shows how the tool creates economic value through both personal and professional use. Adoption is broadening beyond early users, closing gaps and making AI a part of everyday life.
summaryZh: OpenAI发布研究报告，分析了ChatGPT在个人与专业领域的经济价值及普及情况，显示AI应用正逐渐融入日常生活。

aiReview.reasonZh: 该内容为市场调研报告，缺乏大模型技术演进或具体应用落地的技术细节。
